trade_signal_doctrine.entry_logic: Preemptive entry at predicted wick-rejection zone (defensive staff) with tight SL; no waiting for confirmation.
confluences: Confluence 1: Smart Money Concepts (SMC), Supply and Demand, and Trend Indicators. The H4 trend is strongly bearish, characterized by a series of lower highs and lower lows. On H1, a clear bearish Order Block / Supply Zone has formed between 1.15442 and 1.15484. This aligns with the downward-sloping EMA50/200 and a bearish Ichimoku cloud, indicating that any retracement into this supply zone is highly likely to face heavy institutional selling pressure.

Confluence 2: Fair Value Gap (FVG), Candle Range Theory (CRT), and Momentum Indicators. An unmitigated H1 Fair Value Gap (FVG) exists between 1.15442 and 1.15469. According to Candle Range Theory (CRT), the equilibrium of the H1 10:00 candle lies at 1.15461, right inside this FVG. Momentum indicators like the M15 RSI at 42.9 confirm bearish control, suggesting that a preemptive limit order at the 50% FVG fill (1.15456) will capture the exact wick-rejection point as momentum exhausts.

Confluence 3: Malaysian SNR (MSNR), Break of Structure (BOS), and Volatility Indicators. The level 1.15450 represents a major Malaysian SNR Support-Become-Resistance (SBR) level, where previous H1 support (lows of 06:00 and 07:00 at 1.15449 and 1.15464) was broken via a clean Break of Structure (BOS) to the downside. Volatility indicators (M15 ATR at 0.00027 and contracting Bollinger Bands) suggest a low-volatility retracement back to this SBR level before an explosive expansion downward.

Confluence 4: Fibonacci Retracement, Quarter Theory, and Volume Indicators. The entry price of 1.15456 aligns precisely with the 50% Fibonacci retracement of the recent H1 swing high (1.15565) to swing low (1.15347). This level is situated just below the 1.15500 major Quarter Theory level, acting as a psychological barrier. Volume indicators show declining volume on the current upward retracement, confirming a lack of buying pressure and validating the defensive staff zone.

Confluence 5: Candlestick Patterns, Chart Patterns, and Standard Deviation. The H1 timeframe exhibits a dominant bearish engulfing pattern (10:00 to 11:00), forming a bearish continuation flag/pennant on the M15 chart. Standard Deviation analysis shows that a retracement to 1.15456 brings price to the +1.5 SD boundary of the short-term mean, presenting an optimal, high-probability wick-rejection entry with minimal drawdown.
